summary: New box Part. Pass.: example for sense 1 in Part. Pass. (Jan 2.4/946)

data.turoyo: Axulu fako, ṭrawu fako. D howe mqamro, kmətxəl šaḥino kule, ʕaynan hawxa mərlelan.
data.translation: Eat a piece, leave a piece. If it is toasted, it is all eaten hot; he said exactly this to us.

rationale: New Detransitive Part. Pass. box and numbered result-state sense.
mqamro predicates the roasted state of bread under howe, as opposed to the active toasting event; new Detransitive Part. Pass. evidence, one passage.
